identity.title: Resolving CO (2-1) in z ∼ 1.6 Gas-rich Cluster Galaxies with ALMA: Rotating Molecular Gas Disks with Possible Signatures of Gas Stripping

paper_type_evidence.quote: Using ALMA, we detect CO (2–1) in eight $z\sim1.6$ cluster galaxies, all within a single 70$''$ primary beam, in under three hours of integration time.

method.value: Natural-weighted cubes at 50 and 100 km/s; moment 0 over channels with >~2 sigma emission; moment 1 from pixels >3 sigma
